description: Return the Nodecraft billing URL that would let the user buy more server slots, more backup storage, or more RAM for one server. This only produces a link. The user must open it and pay themselves, and nothing on the account changes. Use it when the account is at a limit and the user asked how to raise it.

instance.description: Instance id or exact name. Required for kind "ram"; ignored otherwise.

kind.description: What to upgrade: "instances" for more server slots, "backup" for more backup storage, or "ram" for more RAM on one server.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get Upgrade Link
